environment.method: ABAB (five A/B/A/B blocks, ten sessions/app); Event Timing and trace scripting from tools/gates/perf.ts runScenario. A/A samples are ten adjacent paired repeats per app/scenario/throttle. 1x differs only by CDP throttle rate; 4x uses the harness rate. A/A bands are p95 absolute paired deltas; significance requires |median difference| to exceed the larger app-specific A/A band for that metric.
